description.value: De id van de DeviceUseStatement van de eerste entry van sectie Medische hulpmiddelen.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is DeviceUseStatement and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry[0].reference or fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(DeviceUseStatement/[^/]+)$', '$1') = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry[0].reference or ('DeviceUseStatement/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry[0].reference)).resource.id

Bundle.entry.where(resource is DeviceUseStatement and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry[0].reference or fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(DeviceUseStatement/[^/]+)$', '$1') = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry[0].reference or ('DeviceUseStatement/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry[0].reference)).resource.select(iif(status.exists(), status, clinicalStatus.coding.code.first()))
